flagged.comment: Project proposes 39 multifamily residential units. LDC § 25-1-703(B)(4) requires multifamily projects to be located within one-half mile walking distance of a public transit route, or documentation of an approved director's waiver. No evidence of transit route proximity or director's waiver documentation is provided in the site plan or submittal materials.
areas: site location relative to transit network

flagged.comment: Multifamily residential use proposed (39 units). Requirement: project must be within one-half mile walking distance of a public transit route, or a director's waiver must be obtained. Neither transit proximity nor a director's waiver is documented on the site plan or in the submittal materials. Transit accessibility and any waiver determination must be verified or documented.

Site plan does not demonstrate compliance with multifamily residential transit proximity requirement. No documentation is provided confirming the project is within one-half mile walking distance of a public transit route, nor is documentation of an approved director's waiver provided. Transit route information is absent from the project location map and vicinity documentation.

Project is identified as 'Valley View Townhomes' but site plan and application materials also designate the use as multifamily residential and condominium without explicit confirmation that each townhouse unit is located on a separate townhouse lot per LDC § 25-2-775. Master Comment Report SP3 (dated September 2025) requested clarification of proposed use, and this comment remains uncleared as of latest update. Confirmation of townhouse lot structure and compliance with § 25-2-775 lot requirements is not provided.
areas: entire site layout and unit configuration

flagged.comment: Project proposes 39 townhome units but units are not located on separate townhouse lots as required by LDC § 25-2-775. Instead, units are grouped in multi-unit buildings (4-plexes, 5-plexes, and 6-plexes) with no individual lot lines delineated. The entire development is on a single lot (Lot 1, Mecey Subdivision) and the site data table identifies the use as Multi-Family Residential. If townhouse designation is intended, each unit must be on a separate townhouse lot; alternatively, the project must be redesignated as Multifamily Residential and all documentation revised.

Site is located within a Nonconforming Signs Ordinance area per facts.md. While site plan includes a general note that 'All signs must comply with requirements of the Land Development Code (Chapter 25-10),' the site plan does not specifically address compliance with LDC § 25-10-152 Nonconforming Signs Ordinance area requirements. Area-specific signage standards must be explicitly documented.

Site is located in a Nonconforming Signs Ordinance area per LDC § 25-10-152. While the site plan includes a general sign compliance note stating all signs must comply with Chapter 25-10, specific compliance with the nonconforming signs ordinance requirements is not demonstrated. Site plan must include a note confirming that all signage complies with LDC § 25-10-152 requirements for nonconforming signs ordinance areas.

Site is zoned MF-2 (less restrictive than MF-4) and located within 25 feet of an adjacent SF-3-zoned parcel, triggering Article 10 Compatibility Standards per LDC § 25-2-1051. Current Article 10 requirements (height limits, compatibility buffers, screening, lighting, and noise restrictions) are not demonstrated on the site plan. No analysis addressing the 40-foot height limit within 50 feet of the SF-3 property line, the 25-foot compatibility buffer along the shared property line, or other § 25-2-1063 requirements is provided.
areas: entire site relative to adjacent SF-3 parcel

flagged.comment: No compatibility notes are included on the site plan specifying which LDC sections apply to this project. Current Article 10 ordinance (Ord. 20240516-004, effective July 15, 2024) requires compatibility notes reflecting current code provisions. Notes must address applicability of height limits, buffer and setback standards, screening, lighting, and noise restrictions per LDC §§ 25-2-1051–25-2-1063.

Project is identified as a residential condominium. LDC § 25-2-776 establishes standards for condominium use, including open space and other applicable requirements. Compliance with § 25-2-776 requirements is not explicitly demonstrated in the site plan data table or notes.
